page.overview:
Who is Raijin?

Raijin is a character from Final Fantasy VIII. He is Seifer's friend and is fought against as a boss. He, Fujin, and their leader, Seifer, make up the Balamb Garden disciplinary committee. Despite being physically formidable, Raijin tends to be the underdog of the group whom both Fujin and Seifer boss around.

Raijin is a muscular, dark-skinned 18-year-old man with short black hair and dark brown eyes. He has a chinstrap beard, a silver eyebrow piercing, and three helix piercings on his left ear. He wears a blue vest and long, baggy black pants tied with a red rope belt and black boots. He has white bands around his forearms and wears a large yellow beaded necklace. He wields a long pole in battle. In-game, the insignia on Raijin's shoulder guard is the kanji for "thunder", but in his FMV model, it reads the self-invented kanji for Raijin's name.

In Kingdom Hearts II, Raijin wears a modern outfit as opposed to his primary outfit in the original and appears similar to a hip hopper. He wears an orange sleeveless shirt with black designs on his shoulders, black trousers with two red linings and a number 8 embedded on the left side, and yellow and white sneakers with black soles. He wears blue bands with white outlines and a chain necklace with a lightning pendant.

Fujin tends to kick him when he talks out of line or does something stupid, which happens often. Raijin is bumbling and depends on his friends for guidance on what they should do next. He is implied to be lazy, as when Seifer promotes him to captain, Raijin sneaks off to nap instead of taking care of the duties that he was given. He is fond of insects, as he has checked out several books on the subject from the Balamb Garden library. He tends to add "ya know?" (simply "mon'ya" (もんや) in the Japanese version) to the end of his sentences. Out of Seifer's "posse", Raijin is the friendliest toward Squall and his group and doesn't seem to hold any particular grudge or ill will against them.
